items.detail:
Upstox serves a day's candle only the next morning and NSE's file lands in the
evening, so the screens and Street ka Dalal sat on the previous session until
then (5 Oct published 1 Oct's data all day). Now a provisional bar from Upstox's
last prices goes out after 15:40, NSE's closes replace it when published (with
the differences listed), and Dalal is republished at both steps.
